initial_task:
TASK-MCP-008 - COMPILATION ERROR FIXES
Project: Templum
Folder Path: .claude/handoff/chain-design/2025-09-13-034654-TASK-MCP-008

Task Context:
- Full compilation possible - *all* compilation blocking errors need fixing
- The ValidationSystem scripts should pass on all validator categories for the build assessment (warnings are fine, ERRORS are not)  
- Attempt to spread the work *wide* with this task - i.e. have a few analysis/validation agents to find all the errors/sources of the errors, then have one execution agent per file/component/category for implementing the required fixes and have those same agents attempt to run the ValidationSystem for their category/scope to check that their fixes pass before handing off to the next phase

*DESIGN CHAIN USING v1.3 RISK-ADAPTIVE APPROACH*
Emphasize robust error handling and uncertainty management.

task_specifications.task_description: High-complexity type system fixes with adaptive scope management. Handle complex TypeScript errors, interface mismatches, and architectural type issues. Multi-layer approach: (1) Sophisticated context-aware fixes, (2) Conservative minimal-scope fixes, (3) Basic fixes with manual guidance. Real-time ValidationSystem testing per fix category.

Import/dependency resolution with cascade prevention. Focus on import statements, module resolution, and dependency chain fixes. Adaptive approach: (1) Intelligent path resolution, (2) Conservative import fixes, (3) Basic syntax-only fixes. Continuous monitoring for side effects.

Runtime and configuration fixes with defensive programming. Handle runtime compatibility, configuration issues, and environment-specific errors. Risk-managed approach: (1) Full configuration optimization, (2) Minimal safe configuration, (3) Environment-specific workarounds.

Low-risk syntax and miscellaneous fixes with quality focus. Handle remaining syntax errors, code style issues, and minor compilation blocks. Quality-focused approach: (1) Comprehensive style and syntax fixes, (2) Minimal syntax-only fixes, (3) Error suppression with documentation.

Comprehensive validation with graceful degradation acceptance. Execute full ValidationSystem across all categories with adaptive failure handling. Multi-strategy validation: (1) Full system validation, (2) Category-by-category with partial acceptance, (3) Manual verification with documented issues. Emergency: Partial success documentation.
